Besides placing your verified plastic bottle in the recycling bin, a popular alternative is **creative reuse** or upcycling, which extends the product's life before recycling.

### Repurpose Before Recycling
Instead of immediate disposal, consider crafting something with the bottle. Community discussions highlight simple projects like turning plastic bottles into lanterns, adding value before end-of-life processing:

> [National Day DIY Lantern from a Plastic Bottle 🇨🇳✨ A tiny project that looked way cuter than I expected](/forum/posts/10)

If you decide against upcycling, your previously verified nearby option remains available:
- **Xiaowuji Large Solid Waste Transfer Station** (1,925 m) — Waste transfer station

This ensures the bottle is either reused or recycled responsibly depending on your preference.
